# Retired third-party source

HoroPCA, ChiENN, and the historical EnzGFM integration were removed from the
active dependency area. Their local source repositories remain here with their
licenses and Git metadata. They are not dependencies of V4, F3, or CIRCEv2.

Git publication includes `repositories.json` with the upstream URLs and exact
revisions rather than embedding copies of their Git repositories. Local changes
remain preserved in the workspace and cleanup snapshots. Model weights and
experiment outputs remain at their original local paths.
